top_signals.title: Oil bounces off lows after Iran says deal reached with Oman to share Hormuz revenue
top_signals.summary: Oil fell Wednesday, as investors continue to assess the U.S. pivot toward economic sanctions rather than military strikes to add pressure on Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ashley Flowers Struggles to Grow Podcast Empire
top_signals.summary: Ashley Flowers built 'Crime Junkie' into the second biggest podcast in the US, just after Joe Rogan. But behind the scenes, her podcast company Audiochuck has faced executive turnover, staff departures and growing pains as it tries to expand its true-crime empire. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule changes to White House for review
top_signals.summary: A proposal from the SEC to change its rules governing how investment advisers hold digital assets was sent this week to the White House.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
